artboards.name: home-page
artboards.role: Marketing/ordering home page for Forno Rosso pizzeria: header nav, hero CTA, delivery promo banner, featured menu grid, brand-story section, footer. This is the only artboard on the canvas — no other screens or component masters are present.

tokens.note: Distilled from the frame's own `tokens` block plus per-node fill inspection, compared against design-system/tokens.json. Semantic roles line up closely with the existing token set, but several exact hex/radius values drift — see open_questions for each.

#151212.role: Near-black surface — header, hero section, footer, and the card 'Add to Order' button all fill with this.
#151212.match: approximate — color-fg is a warm dark brown text color, not a neutral near-black surface color

#C82D25.role: Primary red — hero CTA, logo badge, nav active underline, eyebrow labels, story icon badges.
#C82D25.match: approximate — visibly warmer/more vivid than the token

#2A7043.role: Secondary green — delivery-banner background, 'live' ETA highlight in header.
#2A7043.match: approximate — darker/more saturated than the token

radii_px.16: matches radius-lg exactly (menu cards, story images)
radii_px.18: circular icon badge (36x36) — no exact token, implement as 50% radius
radii_px.20: circular icon badge (40x40) — no exact token, implement as 50% radius
radii_px.24: hero image corner — no exact token, closest is radius-lg
radii_px.100: pill chip — matches radius-pill semantically (999px round)

typography.font_family_body: Geist — design system token font-family-body is Inter; same sans-serif role, different exact family
typography.note: Font sizes/weights map loosely onto font-size-sm/md/lg/xl but the frame's ramp is finer-grained (e.g. 40/64px hero display sizes exceed font-size-xl's 28px).

tokens.spacing_note: Broadly a superset of space-1..space-6 (4/8/12/16/24/32), with extra steps (2,6,10,20,40,48,64,80,96,120) used for section padding/gaps that don't exist in the current scale.

open_questions.topic: Primary red color value differs from the existing design-system token
open_questions.detail: Every primary-red usage in this frame (hero CTA, logo badge, nav active underline, eyebrow labels, story icon badges) paints #C82D25, but design-system/tokens.json's color-primary is #b3261e — a visibly different, cooler/darker brick red.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Reuse the existing color-primary token (#b3261e) rather than introduce a second red, since the semantic role is identical and token values are design-system-bootstrap's to change.

options.label: #C82D25 — the exact red painted throughout this frame

open_questions.topic: No existing token for the near-black surface used in header/hero/footer
open_questions.detail: Header, hero section, footer, and the menu-card 'Add to Order' button all fill with #151212. tokens.json has no dark *surface* token — the closest is color-fg (#2a1b12), which is defined for text, not backgrounds, and is a visibly warmer, lighter brown.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Map these backgrounds to color-fg for now and flag that design-system-bootstrap needs to add a real inverse-surface token (e.g. color-surface-inverse).

options.label: #2a1b12 — reuse existing color-fg as the dark surface
#151212 — add a new inverse-surface token matching Figma exactly

open_questions.topic: "Add to Order" button doesn't match either existing button alias
open_questions.detail: The repeated menu-card CTA is a solid near-black (#151212) fill with a white label — it isn't button-primary (red) or button-secondary (white fill / red outline).
open_questions.arc_assumption: Treat it as a third 'dark' button variant, reusing the button-*-radius (radius-md) shape convention, filled with the dark-surface value from missing-dark-surface-token, pending real button-dark-* tokens.

options.label: Add a button-dark-background/foreground alias, reusing radius-md
Recolor these CTAs to button-primary (red) instead, matching Figma's only two defined button variants

open_questions.topic: Hero's outline button needs a light-on-dark treatment
open_questions.detail: "Explore Full Menu" is a transparent button with a white 1px border and white label, sitting on the hero's dark background. The existing button-secondary-* tokens assume a light page background (white fill, red border/text) and would render wrong (near-invisible border) here.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Introduce a light-on-dark outline treatment (transparent fill, color-fg-inverse border/text) scoped to dark sections, rather than reusing button-secondary as-is.

options.label: Add a light-on-dark outline button treatment for dark sections
Reuse button-secondary tokens as-is (white border/text will barely read against the hero background)

open_questions.topic: Delivery-banner green differs slightly from color-secondary
open_questions.detail: The delivery banner background and the header's '30 mins' live-status highlight both use #2A7043, vs. the existing color-secondary token #4b7f52 — same basil-green family, visibly darker/more saturated in Figma.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Reuse the existing color-secondary token; the drift is small enough not to block implementation.

open_questions.topic: Menu card border differs slightly from color-border
open_questions.detail: Menu item cards stroke with #EBE7DF vs. the existing color-border token #e4d6c3 — both light warm neutrals, very close.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Reuse the existing color-border token; treat the drift as within acceptable tolerance.

open_questions.topic: Several corner radii fall outside the existing radius scale
open_questions.detail: Figma uses 18px and 20px corner radii for circular icon badges (36x36 and 40x40) and 24px for the hero image corner, none of which are exactly radius-sm/md/lg/pill (4/8/16/999).
open_questions.arc_assumption: Implement the circular badges with a true 50% border-radius (so the fixed-px mismatch doesn't matter) and use radius-lg for the hero image rather than introducing a new 24px scale step.

open_questions.topic: Section-heading divider rule appears in the menu section but not the story section
open_questions.detail: "Popular Sourdough Pizzas" (6:57) has a short red rule beneath it (6:58); the story section's matching eyebrow+title pattern (6:110) does not draw one.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Model SectionHeading with an optional `divider` prop, present only where the source frame draws it.

open_questions.topic: Header cart badge count is a static "3"
open_questions.detail: The header cart button shows a hardcoded count of 3, with no empty-cart (0/hidden) state drawn anywhere in the frame.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Build the count as a dynamic prop driven by real cart state; render 0 as hidden/absent per common cart-UX convention since no empty state was designed.

open_questions.topic: Purpose/visibility of the header's live delivery-ETA status isn't specified
open_questions.detail: The header always shows "Estimated delivery: 30 mins" with the value highlighted in secondary green, implying dynamic, order-specific state, but the frame doesn't indicate whether/when this should show, hide, or change copy (e.g. no active order).
open_questions.arc_assumption: Treat it as an always-visible header status slot, populated with a static/placeholder ETA until real order-state wiring exists.

open_questions.topic: Hero badge icon is named 'fire-extinguisher' but renders as a flame
open_questions.detail: The icon inside the hero's 'Authentic Neapolitan Woodfired' chip is named 'fire-extinguisher' in the Figma layer tree, but its vector path reads visually as a flame/fire icon — almost certainly a stock icon-library id, not intentional imagery.
open_questions.arc_assumption: Implement the visual glyph shown (a flame) using whatever name the team's actual icon set uses for it, ignoring the literal Figma layer name.
